title: ShopLite 100% error rate — database dependency unreachable
description: ShopLite is returning HTTP 503 on all requests to /products, /orders, and /health. Pods are running but not ready (readiness probe fails with 503). Logs show 'Database unreachable'. FAULT=db_down is active or DB_URL points to an unreachable host. Deployment itself was healthy — fault injected post-deploy.
